about_the_game:
Weapons of Lore for 5th Edition



From: Jeff Stevens Games


Weapons of Lore is a 5E supplement filled with new, unique, and wondrous magic weapons. The supplement includes:

<ul> <li> Progressing Weapons - 42 weapons that increase in power with the character.</li>
<li> Cursed Weapons - 32 weapons that help, but also hinder.</li>
<li> Rechargeable Weapons - 32 weapons with limited charges. Rather than recharging after a rest, these unique creations require a completed task or special material to recharge.</li>
<li> Enterprising Entrepreneurs - 5 individuals or groups who may assist the characters in recharging their unique weapons.</li>
<li> Traditional Weapons - 41 standard magical weapons.</li>
<li> Encounters - More than 300 encounter ideas to help you introduce these rare treasures to the characters. Each of these may also inspire your own one-shot adventure or random encounter.</li>
<li> Applied to Villains - Suggestions on how you might apply these weapons to your campaign's villains, making them Bigger & Badder.</li>
</ul>"
